title: The Free Table
logline: On a dry-zone road with no restaurant in sight, a family that has fed passing strangers for free every day for years hands Chathura a plate before he even asks, and keeps insisting it was nothing.

object.note: Object 6 (identity not chosen) could enter only if something is genuinely given freely to Chathura along with the meal. Never staged.

thread_in.thread: In that gap, goodness can be chosen: from a festival stall's free food to a roadside family that has fed passing strangers for years and hands Chathura a plate before he asks.

thread_out.thread: Giving without keeping count becomes weighing honestly when no one checks: a market vendor whose old scales nobody doubts.

requirements: A genuine roadside stall or household that feeds passing strangers without payment as an ongoing practice
Willingness to be filmed over enough time to show the pattern, not a single staged act
Real traffic and real strangers, not arranged visitors

suggestions.name: A road-side rest stop in the North Central dry zone
suggestions.why: This stretch has long-standing traditions of free wayside food and drink for travellers.
suggestions.verify: No specific stall or family has been identified or confirmed.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed.
